mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is easing monetary policy, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth below -100,000 jobs signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer and business confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 106.0 signals robust manufacturing activity, which increases corporate earnings expectations and equity valuation multiples, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in robust periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) falling below 104.0 signals weak manufacturing activity, which dampens corporate earnings expectations and equity valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weak periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,200K units indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and equity valuation multiples, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strong demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 1,000K units signals weak consumer demand, which dampens corporate earnings expectations and equity valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weak demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
